outcome: The harness tool registry covers browser, image analysis, document parsing, database migration, and web-api tools with allow/deny by role and task and records calls that affect delivery as evidence
acceptance: a caller lists browser, image, document-parse, database-migration, and web-api tools
a role or task that is not allowed is denied
document.parse extracts text and records delivery evidence
image.analyze extracts image text and records delivery evidence
database.migrate applies schema and records delivery evidence
web-api.call uses call-time transport without persisting secrets
browser.navigate runs locally and fails loud when a hosted fleet is requested
tool calls that affect delivery appear on the WorkItem evidence summary
inScope: browser, image, document-parse, database-migration, and web-api registry entries
local invoke adapters and delivery evidence
call-time web-api transport without persisted secrets
assumptions: filesystem, terminal, git, test, and CI tools already exist in the registry
document and image extraction already exist for intake attachments
SQLite migrate already exists on huntianling.database
